text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute suffers an injury during
training, so
we head to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'm awfully sorry for wasting all this time.
I'm so
careless sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That being said, this is barely a scratch.
There's
no need to worry about me.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't even hurt anymore, so how
about we
get back to training?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't even hurt anymore, so how
about we
get back to training?
choice_data_list: 念のため休んでおこう
choice_data_list_en: Let's rest up, just to be safe.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh pish posh... I'm sure I can handle a
little light
exercise.
choice_data_list: 念のため休んでおこう
choice_data_list_en: Let's rest up, just to be safe.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I see. You're suggesting we err on the
side of
caution.
choice_data_list: しっかり治してから思い切り動こう
choice_data_list_en: Let's get you fully healed before going all out.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: All right. If you say rest, then I'll rest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can tell she doesn't like it, but Wonder
Acute
accepts my decision.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Well then, let's get back to it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We decide to return to training, but...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
The pain's come back a little. I might be
pushing
my limits here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We decide to put off training for the
rest of the
day at Wonder Acute's
suggestion.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Well then, let's get back to it.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm. Yeah, I think I'll be just fine at
this pace.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Let's keep this up and get back in the
groove!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that, Wonder Acute continues
training at a
pace she can handle.
